text.en: Doubling a drug's dose will double how long it stays in the body -- in reality, half-life for a first-order-elimination drug is independent of the starting concentration: doubling the dose roughly doubles the concentration at every point in time, but the time to fall by half stays the same regardless of the starting amount.
text.et: Ravimi annuse kahekordistamine kahekordistab selle organismis püsimise aja -- tegelikult on esimest järku eritumisega ravimi poolestusaeg algkontsentratsioonist sõltumatu: annuse kahekordistamine kahekordistab ligikaudu kontsentratsiooni igal ajahetkel, kuid poolenemiseks kuluv aeg jääb samaks olenemata algkogusest.
